evidence: 見出しと本文：仙台89ERSの直近5試合は5勝0敗。

prompt.initial:
Use case: ads-marketing / editorial sports illustration.
Create exactly ONE finished Japanese basketball article thumbnail, horizontal 16:9, 1600 x 900 px or larger. Opaque PNG. Brand: バスケまとめ. This is a completely new thumbnail for the fixed manuscript dated 2026-11-19.

Visual guidance: Match the approved black and lime reference thumbnail already viewed in this conversation: near-black #151A18 background, fluorescent lime #CCF43B brush swashes, off-white heavy Japanese typography, energetic hand-drawn ink hatching, bold brush textures, very few elements. Do NOT carry over any names, dates, scores or numbers from the reference thumbnails.

Subject: The ONE and only person is real basketball player Jarrett Culver (ジャレット・カルバー). He is the featured player in the fixed article section 「中心はカルバー選手」. Base his likeness on the official Sendai 89ERS portrait viewed immediately before this request (official roster portrait, filename 51000531_01.jpg): short dense upright black textured curls with tapered sides, long slim oval face, prominent ears, dark almond eyes, defined cheekbones, medium-wide nose, slight moustache and sparse short chin beard, long neck, slim athletic muscular build. Preserve these specific facial features. He must be recognisable as Culver and not a generic invented athlete. Draw him entirely as a crisp expressive ink illustration, not a photograph or photorealistic rendering. No pasted official photo.

Composition: Culver on the LEFT approximately 42% of the canvas, in a dynamic low driving dribble pose, torso angled forward, face visible in three-quarter view, gaze focused across the frame. His right hand controls an orange basketball below waist level, anatomically natural wrist and visible fingers. The other arm balances the drive. The basketball remains a prop held/controlled by the player. Show head, torso, both arms and upper legs without clipping face, hands or ball. Use a plain sleeveless yellow-lime uniform with dark trim, no logos, no sponsor text, no lettering or jersey numbers. A restrained diagonal lime brush stroke behind him evokes motion. No other people. No crowd, arena, scoreboard, hoop or specific match scene. This is a conceptual illustration based on statistics, not a recreation or a claim about a particular play.

Typography on the RIGHT about 55% of canvas with generous 55px outer margins. Keep all text horizontal, crisp, spelled exactly, separated from the player and not intersecting his face or hands. Clear editorial hierarchy with huge heavy Japanese sans-serif. The main 5 and 0 are luminous lime, 勝 and 敗 off-white. The next figure 41.5% is large off-white/lime and explicitly grouped with the TEAM statistic label. Retain the decimal point and percent sign. The two figures must be easy to read at thumbnail size.

Render ONLY these exact text strings:
「バスケまとめ」 (small masthead)
「仙台89ERS」
「直近5試合」
「5勝0敗」 (largest headline)
「チーム3P成功率」
「41.5%」 (large second headline)
「対象：11/6〜11/18」 (small but legible under statistics)
「イラスト（AI生成）」 (legible bottom footer)
「成績をもとにしたイメージ」 (legible bottom footer)

Factual scope: These are Sendai TEAM totals/rate for the latest five games, November 6 through November 18, as stated by the fixed manuscript, NOT Culver's personal 3-point percentage. No league ranking, no season-average claim, no unsupported superlatives, no claim of 5 consecutive wins as the full current streak, no additional player performance numbers. No player name text is necessary. Do not add or invent any other words or numbers.
Constraints: one image only; illustrated real player as main subject; natural hands and anatomy; face/hands/ball/text fully inside frame; team and league logos absent; no official photo pixels; avoid clutter and photorealism; retain BOTH exact AI and conceptual-illustration labels.
